name: Henshi~n!
source: Sakagami's life was going downhill, especially his love life. Until the day he gained the ability to transform himself...into anything he can imagine. He decided to take this chance and fix everything that was wrong with his life...
translation: 坂上的人生每况愈下，感情生活尤其糟糕。直到有一天，他获得了变身能力……可以变成任何自己想象得到的东西。他决定抓住这次机会，修正人生中所有出错的事……
